scripts.build: pnpm --filter @drawless/shared build && pnpm --filter @drawless/server build && pnpm --filter @drawless/web build
scripts.check: pnpm --filter @drawless/shared test && pnpm --filter @drawless/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @drawless/shared build && pnpm --filter @drawless/server test && pnpm --filter @drawless/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @drawless/server build && pnpm --filter @drawless/server smoke && pnpm --filter @drawless/web test:unit && pnpm --filter @drawless/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @drawless/web build
scripts.dev:coworker:stack: pnpm dev:coworker & pnpm dev:server:coworker & pnpm dev:web
scripts.smoke:coworker-control: npm --prefix apps/coworker run build && pnpm --filter @drawless/server smoke:coworker-control
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @drawless/shared test && pnpm --filter @drawless/server test && pnpm --filter @drawless/web test:unit
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @drawless/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @drawless/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @drawless/web typecheck
